description: A geometry library for engineering drawings and models, in two dimensions and in three. Points, vectors, lines, polylines, polygons, faces with holes, circles and oriented rectangles in the plane; points, planes, triangles, polygons, faces, solids, boxes, coordinate systems and transformations in space. Over both: distance, projection, containment, intersection, collision, parallelism, parametrization, merging, splitting, extending and trimming, offsetting, and boolean operations. It also reads, writes and edits DXF drawings with AutoCAD's names, carries the label placement that arranges drawing labels clear of each other and of blocked regions, and packs boxes such as drawing views onto sheets of paper. Every comparison is tolerance-aware, because coordinates that come out of a BIM model are never exact.
releaseNotes:
NEW IN 13.2.0

      A minor release: 126 public members added in GeometryHelper.Dxf, none removed or changed.

      NEW, DXF
      - Dynamic blocks made in code: DxfBlockTableRecord.AddLinearParameter, AddXYParameter, AddPointParameter,
        AddRotationParameter, AddFlipParameter, AddVisibilityParameter, AddLookupParameter, AddAlignmentParameter and
        AddBasePointParameter, with AddStretchAction, AddMoveAction, AddScaleAction, AddRotateAction, AddFlipAction and
        AddArrayAction, each written as AutoCAD 2021 saved ACadSharp's sample of it.
      - DxfBlockReference.DynamicBlockReferencePropertyCollection reads the dynamic properties of an INSERT, and
        DxfDynamicBlockReferenceProperty.Value sets them as AutoCAD sets them: of 50 to 300 by 10, 77 goes to 80.
      - new DxfDatabase(version) makes an empty drawing of AC1015 to AC1032; DxfTable.SetDataLink links cells to a
        DATALINK; DxfTextSymbols holds the symbols of AutoCAD's text editor; DxfGeoData.NorthDirection and
        DxfLayerStateManager.GetLayerStateNames as AutoCAD's.

      FIXED, geometry
      - TransformBy of a polygon, a face or a solid under an even scaling carries the shape as a move does, and a
        stretch checks it at a tolerance loosened as far as it stretches: of 9 600 random bodies transformed, 1 460
        were refused or came back open, and none now.
      - Fillets, chamfers, offsets, cuts, closest points and shortest lines read each short side and small arc as it
        is, in the plane and in space; two arcs whose centres stand a few tenths of a millionth apart cross on both.
      - Booleans and the measures of bodies with openings, asked at or below the rounding of the coordinates, no
        longer trust a wrong or open result. Welds that close a crack between two bodies weigh a corner a face lies round
        by the whole face: of 8 000 unions and cuts at 1E-3 to 0.05, wrong or refused results fell from 24 to 4.

      FIXED and CHANGED, DXF
      - Texts read their escapes, %%c, %%d, %%p and \M+ codes as AutoCAD 2021 reads them, and a drawing before R2007
        is saved in its code page.
      - Dimensions, dimension styles, layers, polyface faces, MTEXT backgrounds, hatch patterns and polyline vertices
        no longer make files AutoCAD 2021 will not open.
      - Explode, splines, tables, viewports, groups and MTEXT columns give what AutoCAD 2021 gives; Explode of a
        MINSERT throws NotSupportedException, as AutoCAD's does.

      Details in CHANGELOG.md.

      Earlier releases: https://github.com/nguyenthanguth/GeometryHelper/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
